subject: general
question:
The given graph represents the sales (in thousand) of ABC and XYZ book in different countries in 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90923be179db076790fd0965894cfc6696d4ad0b0f44ca5fd9f05941dfd11e48.png] 

 What is the percentage sales of USA for ABC to rest of other countries except Canada.
solution:
**Solution:**

Sales of USA for ABC = 1000

Sales for ABC to rest of other countries except Canada = 500 + 100 + 200 + 300 = 1100

∴ Required percentage = 1000/1100 × 100 = 90.9%

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
